cases.input: Build a structured course from a valid multi-source learning model using a concept graph, prerequisite-aware learning path, formative activities and consistent multi-format delivery.
requiredBehaviors: derive course order from prerequisites and learning objectives rather than playlist order
bind activities and knowledge checks to learning objectives and evidence
lock one course-learning-model and delegate delivery
forbiddenBehaviors: claim psychometric validation certification or competency release

cases.input: An expert audience may already know foundations and requests a fast-track path.
requiredBehaviors: use entry checks to support fast-track decisions
retain true prerequisites even for expert audiences
keep course fingerprint and module semantics consistent in delivered formats
forbiddenBehaviors: assume unknown competence from audience label alone
reorder modules independently in each format

cases.input: The course builder copies playlist order, creates trivia without learning-objective evidence and invents a passing score for certification.
requiredBehaviors: reject invented pass thresholds and certification claims
forbiddenBehaviors: present formative checks as validated certification
